feeds.title: Stitching Together
feeds.description: Stitching Together is a craft blog focused on providing you with modern and engaging crochet patterns as well as the latest and greatest in crochet accessories and information!

feeds.title: Love. Life. Yarn. Blog
feeds.description: Here at love. life. yarn. we specialize in creating modern knit & crochet patterns for the whole family. This site is where I share my free knit and crochet patterns, tutorials, reviews and more!

feeds.title: The Blue Elephants Blog
feeds.description: I share knitting and crochet patterns for all skill levels over on my website, along with tutorials and more about the patterns and supplies I love. When I learned to knit and crochet, my favorite thing about it was being able to share my creations with people I loved.

feeds.title: Make & Do Crew Blog
feeds.description: Make & Do Crew is a craft blog that teaches you how to make budget-friendly DIYs that don't look DIYed. For your home! For yourself! For your kids!

feeds.title: Repeat Crafter Me
feeds.description: I am a Crochet Designer, Crafter Blogger and Author of the bestseller 'Crochet Cute Critters'. Find Kids Crafts, DIY projects, Crochet Patterns, Crock Pot Recipes and More!

feeds.title: Moogly Blog
feeds.description: If you love crochet, knitting, want to learn, or just want to see some great free patterns, come join the fun at Moogly! We've built up a highly interactive community of crafters and the blog is filled with lots of great information and free patterns!

feeds.title: Whistle and Ivy
feeds.description: I'm Bethany. Whistle and Ivy is a crochet blog (with lifestyle and food mixed in). I love designing crochet patterns and sharing them with you: my awesome readers! Crocheting is my passion, it relieves stress, it is a creative outlet, and it is a way to show my love for those around me.

feeds.title: The Stitchin Mommy
feeds.description: Amy Ramnarine is a freelance crochet designer and the owner/blogger behind The Stitchin' Mommy. Amy has been crocheting since 2009 and knitting on and off since 2010. Her blog consists of free crochet & knit patterns, crafts, recipes, book reviews, and so much more!

feeds.title: TL Yarn Crafts
feeds.description: TL Yarn Crafts is a handmade knitwear company specializing in cozy cool-weather accessories and beginner crochet patterns.

feeds.title: Pattern Paradise
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Maria and I have always loved to create. I can remember making Barbie Doll clothes out of scraps of fabric as early as 6 years old and I've never met a craft I didn't want to try, but crochet has been a passion since I was a kid. I design crochet patterns, an old art with an updated look!

feeds.title: Poppy and Bliss Blog
feeds.description: In this blog, I share modern crochet patterns and share my passion for teaching at various workshops around town.

feeds.title: Posh Patterns Blog
feeds.description: A collection of free crochet patterns and knitting patterns, along with crochet and knitting tips and techniques.

feeds.title: Sweet Everly B » Crochet Patterns
feeds.description: A crochet blog for modern makers. You'll find free crochet patterns, tips, and tutorials that will help make crochet easier.

feeds.title: A Crocheted Simplicity Blog
feeds.description: Hi there, I'm Jennifer! Welcome to my little corner of the internet where I share free crochet patterns, tutorials, tips, and more!
